description: Six agents installed as VS Code extensions on Windows, found by extension id.
why: vscode_extensions through the Windows uid list. Every value is the extension's own id, so a VS Code fork's rows would carry the same ids under another `extra`: `forbid` names the forks and desktop apps whose installs are not here. Each extension is the only witness for its agent: no agent's CLI is installed here.
known_gaps: VS Code itself, from its user installer. Cursor and Windsurf read the same extension directories under their own names and are not exercised here.
